elements.title: Cover page of Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024
elements.content: Background image showing a close-up of a semiconductor wafer or microchip with colorful reflections and a blurred hand on the right side. Overlaid text includes: 'U.S. Department of the Interior U.S. Geological Survey', 'MINERAL COMMODITY SUMMARIES 2024', and a list of mineral commodities arranged in four columns.
elements.notes: No tables, charts, maps, or diagrams present on this page.
